title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
**Role: Service Desk Analyst (L1)**

**Experience: 2–5 years in an IT service desk or end-user support role**

**Location: Chennai or Coimbatore, India**

**Responsibilities:**

* Answer phone, chat, email, Virtual Agent and portal contacts, and log, categorize and prioritize each one in ServiceNow.

* Resolve L1 incidents on first contact, such as Okta sign-in and MFA, password resets, Outlook, Teams, GlobalProtect VPN and laptop problems.

* Fulfil catalog and access requests within target times: 1 business day for access after approval, 2 business days by default for catalog items.

* Own each ticket from creation to closure, including tickets escalated to client L2/L3 groups or vendors.

* Escalate with complete notes and the correct assignment group (first-time-right target of 90% or higher).

* Spot possible major incidents and raise them straight away to the Shift Manager or Incident/Change Manager on duty.

* Pod focus — Frontline: calls, chat and incidents. Access & Identity: account lifecycle (JML), SSO, licences, app access. Endpoint & Asset: laptop assignment and retrieval, wipes, asset records.

**Key relationships:**

* Shift Manager (manager).

* Incident/Change Manager on duty for possible major incidents.

* Client users, including VIPs, and client resolver groups.

* Desktop Engineering for device escalations.

**Requirements:**

* 2–5 years in an IT service desk or end-user support role; 24x7 or multi-site desk experience preferred.

* Hands-on ServiceNow ITSM experience.

* Active Directory and Entra ID, Okta (password resets, MFA, app assignment) and SSO troubleshooting.

* Microsoft 365 support: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint permissions, licences.

* Windows 10/11 and macOS troubleshooting, with basic Intune or Jamf.

* Clear written and spoken English, and willingness to work rotational shifts, including nights and weekends.

**Preferred:**

* ITIL 4 Foundation.

* Microsoft MD-102 or MS-900, or an Okta certification.

* Experience with ServiceNow Virtual Agent or AI-assisted service desk tools.

**Tools and technologies:**

* ServiceNow ITSM and Virtual Agent.

* Okta, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID.

* Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint.

* Intune, Jamf, GlobalProtect VPN, Bomgar remote support.

**Skills and behaviours:**

* Friendly, clear communicator.

* Owns the ticket until it is closed.

* Accurate with high volumes.

* Curious and keen to learn.

**Your first 90 days:**

* 30 days: complete client onboarding (about 2 weeks) and internal certification; learn your pod's top request types.

* 60 days: handle live contacts at target handle times; cross-train in a second pod.

* 90 days: meet first-contact resolution and quality targets; contribute knowledge articles.

**How success is measured:**

* P1/P2 response within 30 minutes; access requests fulfilled within 1 business day.

* First-time-right routing of 90% or higher; reopen rate of 7% or lower.

* Ticket quality audit average of 90% or higher.

* Knowledge articles created or updated each month.

**Working arrangements:**

* India-based, rotational shifts in a follow-the-sun 24x7 model with 30-minute handovers; weekend and holiday cover on rota.

**Requirements for every role:**

* Pass a background check under local law before getting access to client systems.

* Complete client security and privacy training, including FERPA and COPPA, and an annual refresher.

Benefits:

title: GMS-Senior-SAP Security And SAP GRC AC
description:
Location: Coimbatore

Other locations: Anywhere in Country

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 20, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1761097

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**SAP Security, GRC Access Control and Identity Management Specialist**

Professional Job Description for Modern SAP Landscapes

Scope: SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BW and integrated SAP platforms

  

**Role Type**

SAP Security, GRC, IDM and Access Governance

  

**Seniority**

Senior Analyst / Consultant / Specialist / Lead, depending on experience

  

**Primary Focus**

User access management, role lifecycle, GRC operations, IDM provisioning, risk ruleset management, audits and access reviews

  

**Landscape**

SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC AC/PC, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and related integrations

  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced SAP Security, GRC and Identity Access Management professional to manage end-to-end SAP user access, role design, identity lifecycle, access governance, emergency access, risk analysis, audits and security operations across a complex SAP landscape. The role will support SAP S/4HANA on RISE, SAP GRC Access Control, SAP GRC Process Control, SAP IDM, SAP BTP, SAP Ariba, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP BW/BW4HANA and other integrated SAP applications.

The candidate will be responsible for SAP user management, SAP role design and maintenance, GRC operations, access risk analysis, SAP Firefighter governance, user access review implementation, quarterly access reviews, risk ruleset management, SoD remediation support, country rollouts, SAP native security assessments and audit support. The role requires strong process discipline, documentation quality and audit-ready execution across run, change and project activities.

  

**Key Accountability Areas**

**Area**

**Expected Ownership**

  

**SAP User Access Management**

Create, modify, maintain and revoke SAP user access using approved access request, provisioning and governance processes.

  

**SAP Role Management**

Own role requirement gathering, role design, build, testing, transport, go-live and ongoing maintenance.

  

**SAP GRC Access Control**

Administer GRC Access Control processes across ARA, EAM, ARM and access governance workflows.

  

**SAP GRC Process Control**

Support quarterly CCM updates, control monitoring, exception validation and control evidence management.

**SAP IDM**

Manage identity lifecycle workflows, provisioning, deprovisioning, reconciliation and connector issue resolution.

  

**Access Reviews and Audits**

Implement and operate user access reviews, firefighter reviews, audit evidence packs and remediation tracking.

  

**Risk Ruleset Management**

Design, maintain, test and govern SoD and critical access rulesets for SAP and integrated applications.

  

**SAP Native Security**

Assess SAP authorization, user, privileged access, RFC, technical user and security configuration risks.

  

**Detailed Responsibilities**

**SAP User Access Management**

* Manage SAP user ID creation, modification, lock, unlock, validity updates, role assignment, termination and periodic user maintenance across SAP systems.
* Support access provisioning and deprovisioning through SAP IDM and SAP GRC Access Control workflows.
* Handle access requests, emergency requests, weekend releases and production access support activities.
* Ensure access is provisioned based on approved requests, business need, least privilege and segregation of duties requirements.
* Maintain user master data, license-relevant user classifications, technical users, communication users and validity controls.

  

**SAP Role Management**

* Design, build, test and maintain SAP security roles for SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, Fiori, BTP integrations and related SAP platforms.
* Perform role requirement gathering with business process owners, functional teams, control owners and country rollout teams.
* Translate business requirements into authorization concepts, role matrices, derived roles, composite roles and Fiori catalogs, groups, spaces or pages.
* Own the role lifecycle from requirement gathering, design, build and unit testing through UAT, defect remediation, transport movement, go-live and hypercare.
* Support role redesign, role cleanup, SoD reduction, access optimization and country-specific role rollout activities.

**SAP GRC Access Control Management**

* Administer SAP GRC Access Control modules including Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management and Business Role Management where applicable.
* Configure and support GRC workflows, approval paths, request types, provisioning settings, connectors and access request exceptions.
* Perform access risk analysis for users, roles, access requests and role changes.
* Monitor and resolve GRC provisioning failures, workflow issues, connector errors and control exceptions.
* Support integrated access governance across SAP S/4HANA, BW, Ariba, SuccessFactors, BTP and other connected applications.

**SAP GRC ARA and Risk Ruleset Management**

* Manage SAP GRC ARA risk analysis for users, roles, profiles, critical transactions and sensitive authorization combinations.
* Design, update and maintain SAP risk rulesets including risks, functions, actions, permissions and mitigating controls.
* Perform ruleset impact assessment, regression testing and approval tracking before production deployment.
* Coordinate SoD risk remediation, mitigation control assignment and risk owner sign-off.
* Maintain ruleset documentation, change history, test evidence and version control.

**SAP Firefighter and Emergency Access Management**

* Manage SAP Firefighter ID setup, owner assignment, controller assignment, reason codes and emergency access configuration.
* Support emergency access request, approval, usage monitoring, log review and closure processes.
* Perform SAP GRC Firefighter log reviews and coordinate timely controller review and sign-off.
* Investigate unauthorized, excessive or inappropriate firefighter usage and track remediation actions.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence for firefighter assignment, usage, review, exceptions and approvals.

**SAP User Access Review Implementation and Quarterly Reviews**

* Implement SAP user access review campaigns using SAP GRC or approved access certification tools.
* Prepare user, role, critical access, SoD, privileged access and firefighter review datasets.
* Coordinate quarterly access reviews with managers, role owners, process owners and control owners.
* Track review completion, access retention, revocation, exceptions, remediation actions and management approvals.
* Maintain complete evidence for internal audit, external audit and compliance reporting.

**SAP GRC Process Control and Quarterly CCM Updates**

* Support SAP GRC Process Control operations, control mapping, monitoring rules and issue tracking.
* Perform quarterly Continuous Control Monitoring updates based on process, configuration, risk and control changes.
* Maintain CCM business rules, monitoring schedules, exception logic and control owner assignments.
* Coordinate with process owners to validate CCM exceptions, control failures and remediation actions.
* Prepare control evidence, deficiency documentation and management reporting.

**SAP IDM and Identity Lifecycle Management**

* Manage identity lifecycle processes in SAP IDM including joiner, mover, leaver, role assignment, provisioning and deprovisioning workflows.
* Support integrations between SAP IDM, HR source systems, SAP GRC, SAP systems and downstream applications.
* Maintain IDM workflows, connectors, provisioning rules, approval logic and reconciliation processes.
* Troubleshoot provisioning failures, access synchronization issues and identity data inconsistencies.
* Support future-state IAM planning involving SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP IAG or enterprise identity platforms where applicable.

**Country Rollouts and Release Support**

* Support SAP security activities for new country rollouts, company code rollouts, business process deployments and regional templates.
* Gather local access requirements and align them with global role design, control standards and SoD requirements.
* Prepare access matrices, role mapping, test scripts, cutover plans and go-live readiness evidence.
* Support unit testing, UAT, defect resolution, transport movement, weekend release and hypercare activities.
* Ensure country-specific access is secure, approved, tested and audit-ready before production use.

**SAP Native Security Assessment and Audit Support**

* Perform SAP native security assessments across S/4HANA, ECC, BW, GRC, Solution Manager, BTP-integrated applications and other SAP platforms.
* Review SAP authorization objects, critical transactions, privileged users, RFC users, communication users, generic IDs and sensitive access.
* Identify excessive access, weak role design, unused roles, shared IDs, control gaps and configuration weaknesses.
* Support SAP internal audit, external audit, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
* Prepare audit evidence packs, management responses, remediation plans and closure validation evidence.

  

**SAP Application Scope**

SAP S/4HANA on RISE / Private Cloud Edition

SAP GRC Access Control

SAP GRC Process Control

* SAP IDM
* SAP BTP
* SAP Ariba
* SAP SuccessFactors
* SAP BW / BW4HANA
* SAP Fiori Launchpad
* SAP Solution Manager
* SAP Cloud Identity Services / IAS / IPS, where applicable
* Integrated non-SAP systems connected to SAP access governance

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP Security, SAP GRC Access Control and SAP user administration.
* Experience in SAP role design, role build, UAT support, transport movement and production deployment.
* with SAP Firefighter ID management, log review and emergency access governance.
* Experience implementing and operating SAP user access reviews and quarterly access certification processes.
* Experience with SAP IDM provisioning, workflows, connectors and identity lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA security, Fiori security, authorization objects and business role concepts.
* Understanding of SAP GRC Process Control and Continuous Control Monitoring.
* Experience supporting SAP internal audits, external audits, SOX, ITGC and compliance reviews.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, evidence management and issue resolution skills.

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA on RISE or hybrid SAP cloud landscapes.
* Knowledge of SAP BTP security, role collections, identity provider integration and cloud authorization concepts.
* Experience with SAP Ariba and SAP SuccessFactors access governance.
* Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Services, IAS, IPS, SAP IAG or Microsoft Entra ID integration.
* Awareness of cross-application SoD risks across SAP and cloud applications.
* Experience in global SAP template rollouts and country-specific security deployments.
* Knowledge of SOX, ITGC, NIST, ISO 27001 or internal control frameworks.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Cybersecurity & AI Safety Content Strategist
description:
We are looking for a sharp, curious **Cybersecurity & AI Safety Content Strategist** who can turn fast-moving global developments and dense technical research into clear, compelling, plain-English content. Cyber threats, artificial intelligence capabilities, and international regulations are evolving every week—yet most business leaders struggle to separate real operational risks from media hype.

In this role, you will monitor global cybersecurity incidents, AI safety breakthroughs, and regulatory shifts, distilling complex technical findings into accessible articles, executive briefings, social posts, and practical guides that help organizations make smarter, safer decisions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Technical-to-Plain-English Translation:** Digest vulnerability disclosures, threat intelligence reports, AI safety research papers, and compliance updates, and rewrite them into jargon-free, actionable insights for non-technical executives and business owners.
* **Global Current Events & Trend Monitoring:** Track breaking cybersecurity incidents, geopolitical cyber trends, and international AI policy developments (across North America, the EU, and globally) to produce timely, relevant commentary.
* **AI Safety & Governance Content:** Create educational content exploring generative AI risks—such as prompt injection, data leakage, model reliability, and shadow AI—alongside practical governance standards like the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) and ISO/IEC 42001.
* **Multi-Format Content Production:** Write and structure high-performing blog posts, LinkedIn thought-leadership pieces, client newsletters, downloadable checklists, and short-form video/podcast scripts.
* **Editorial Accuracy & Fact-Checking:** Collaborate with technical leads and security practitioners to verify every claim, ensuring content is authoritative, vendor-neutral, and free of fear-mongering.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Cybersecurity & AI Safety Fluency:** Solid foundational understanding of modern cybersecurity concepts (threat landscapes, data privacy, risk management) and core AI safety issues (alignment, data governance, enterprise AI risks).
* **Exceptional Plain-English Writing:** Proven ability to explain complicated technical mechanisms simply—if a busy CEO or board member cannot understand it on the first read, it needs rewriting.
* **Global Awareness:** Active habit of following international tech policy, cybersecurity news, and real-world events shaping how organizations adopt technology.
* **Research & Synthesis Speed:** Strong editorial judgment with the ability to quickly verify primary sources, spot the "so what?" for business readers, and meet consistent publishing deadlines.
* **Familiarity with Industry Frameworks (Preferred):** Working awareness of standards and privacy laws such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, PIPEDA, or HIPAA is a strong asset.
* **Background:** Experience in cybersecurity journalism, technical writing, threat intelligence analysis, GRC communications, or content strategy for B2B tech/security firms (formal degree optional if your portfolio demonstrates mastery).

How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

* **Your Resume or LinkedIn Profile** (plus links to 2–3 relevant writing samples).
* **A Short Plain-English Writing Exercise (250–350 words):** Pick one recent global cybersecurity incident, AI safety development, or regulatory update from the past 30 days and summarize what happened, why it matters to everyday businesses, and one practical step leaders should take—written with zero technical jargon.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore Central, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

title: PowerBI Platform Engineer
description:
About the Role

The Power BI Platform Engineer is responsible for the architecture, administration, scalability, and governance of the enterprise Power BI and Microsoft Fabric ecosystem. Rather than focusing solely on building visual dashboards, this role operates under a platform-engineering mindset—treating BI infrastructure as a managed product. You will oversee workspace design, premium capacity/Fabric capacity management, data refresh optimization, enterprise-scale gateway architectures, and CI/CD deployment pipelines. Working at the intersection of BI developers, enterprise data platform teams, and governance bodies, you ensure high availability, data security, performance standards, and cost-efficient capacity utilization across the entire organization.

Responsibilities

* Tenant Administration & Platform Governance: Manage Power BI tenant settings, capacity configurations, licensing allocation, and organizational governance policies. Implement best practices for workspace lifecycles, access control, and workspace domain hierarchies.
* Capacity & Performance Optimization: Monitor and tune Fabric/Power BI capacities (F-SKUs and P-SKUs) using Microsoft Fabric Capacity Metrics. Identify memory throttling, CPU spikes, and query timeouts, partnering with semantic model developers to resolve bottlenecks.
* Enterprise Gateway Management: Architect, configure, patch, and monitor high-availability On-Premises Data Gateway clusters to ensure resilient hybrid connectivity to on-prem data warehouses and private network endpoints.
* CI/CD & DevOps Automation: Build and standardize automated release management using Power BI Deployment Pipelines, Fabric Git integration (Azure DevOps / GitHub), and PowerShell/Fabric REST APIs for automated deployments, regression checks, and model backups.
* Security & Compliance: Implement data protection policies including Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels, Row-Level Security (RLS) / Object-Level Security (OLS) audit frameworks, and private endpoint / VNet data connectivity.
* Semantic Layer & Data Architecture Enablement: Guide enterprise teams on best practices for large-scale semantic models (Direct Lake, DirectQuery, composite models, XMLA read/write endpoints, and incremental refresh).
* Platform Operations & Support: Serve as the senior technical escalation point for platform-level outages, gateway failures, data refresh disruptions, and tenant misconfigurations.

Requirements

* Experience: 3–6 years of dedicated experience in enterprise BI administration, platform engineering, or enterprise analytics engineering with an emphasis on Power BI / Microsoft Fabric.

title: BI & Semantic Model Engineer
description:
About the Role

The BI & Semantic Model Engineer serves as the critical bridge between raw data lakehouses/warehouses and business intelligence consumers. In this role, you design, build, and optimize governed, enterprise-grade semantic layers that translate complex distributed data schemas into intuitive, performant business models. Rather than simply building front-end charts, you focus on data modeling rigor, calculation design, query performance optimization, and self-service enablement. You will establish single-source-of-truth metric definitions, implement granular security policies (RLS/OLS), and optimize high-throughput analytics pipelines across enterprise BI platforms (such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Cube, or dbt Semantic Layer) and modern cloud data warehouses.

Responsibilities

* Enterprise Semantic Modeling: Architect, build, and maintain centralized tabular semantic models, dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas), and universal metrics layers that serve disparate business units and analytical workloads.
* Calculation & Metric Standardization: Develop, test, and document complex business logic, KPIs, time-intelligence calculations, and metric definitions using advanced analytical languages (DAX, MDX, or semantic engine code like Cube.js / MetricFlow).
* Performance Tuning & Storage Engine Optimization: Optimize query response times, compression, memory footprints, and partition schemes. Transition high-volume datasets across optimal storage modes (Direct Lake, In-Memory/Import, DirectQuery, Aggregations, and Composite models).
* Tooling & Code-First Lifecycle Management: Maintain semantic models as code using developer tooling (Tabular Editor, ALM Toolkit, dbt, or BIML). Manage schema migrations, metadata versioning, and CI/CD deployment pipelines using Git and Azure DevOps/GitHub.
* Security & Governance Architecture: Design and enforce data governance protocols, including dynamic Row-Level Security (RLS), Object-Level Security (OLS), data masking, and sensitivity labels across shared datasets.
* Data Integration & Transformation: Collaborate with Data Engineers to shape raw lakehouse/warehouse schemas (Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric Lakehouse, BigQuery) into analytics-ready curated views and facts/dimensions.
* Auditing & Query Diagnostics: Profile slow-running reports, identify inefficient query execution plans using DAX Studio or database query profilers, and tune relationship cardinalities, filter context evaluation, and materialized aggregates.

Requirements

* Experience: 3–6 years of dedicated experience in enterprise BI engineering, data modeling, or analytics engineering with a primary focus on semantic layer architecture.Advanced Semantic Modeling & DAX: Deep technical mastery of tabular modeling engines, star schemas, bidirectional filtering nuances, and writing efficient, highly performant DAX calculations and window functions.Data Warehousing & SQL Mastery: Exceptional SQL skills for complex data querying, transformation, window functions, and designing optimal dimensional schemas ($Kimball$ methodology).Cloud Data Platforms: Production experience sourcing data from cloud data warehouses/lakehouses such as Snowflake, Azure Synapse / Fabric, Databricks (Delta Lake), or Google BigQuery.Model Engineering Tooling: Hands-on experience with modern semantic developer tools like Tabular Editor 2/3, DAX Studio, and Git-integrated BI deployment workflows.Storage Modes & Data Refresh Architecture: Working knowledge of optimizing incremental refreshes, hybrid partitions, DirectQuery caching limits, and modern engine features like Direct Lake on Delta Parquet files.Data Governance & Security: Proven track record implementing scalable dynamic security frameworks (RLS/OLS) driven by Active Directory/Entra ID groups or custom entitlement tables.

Nice to Have

* Universal Semantic Layers: Experience with headless or universal semantic layer tools (e.g., Cube, dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, GoodData, or AtScale).
* Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in Python or PowerShell for programmatic model management (e.g., using Tabular Object Model / TOM, PyPowerBI, or Semantic Link / SemPy).
* XMLA / API Operations: Familiarity with script-based dataset management via XMLA endpoints, TMSL (Tabular Model Scripting Language), or Fabric/Power BI REST APIs.
* Modern Orchestration: Familiarity with data transform orchestration tools such as dbt Core/Cloud, Apache Airflow, or Fabric Data Factory.
* Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600), Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300), or SnowPro Core Certification.

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹130,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

* Do you have Experience in Git/Azure DevOps?
